fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    try {
    val req = mapper.readValue("{\"file\":\"audio.mp3\",\"model\":\"whisper-1\"}", CreateTranscriptionRequest::class.java)
    val result = LiterLlm.transcribe(req)

}
